task.title: Move gate requirements from quality to policy
task.summary: Create src/policy/** as the owner of gate requirements, risk tiers, approvals, proof requirements, and production-readiness policy; remove quality as policy owner.

goal.outcome: Policy owns rules and requirements while checks produce evidence and gateway emits verdicts.
acceptance: src/policy/** owns gate requirements, risk tiers, proof requirements, approvals, and production profile policy.
src/quality/** is removed or reduced to historical compatibility-free absence; live imports use policy naming.
Gateway/report/build code consumes policy functions instead of local duplicate required-audit/risk constants where this task touches them.
Tests enforce policy dependency direction: policy does not import gateway or checks executors.
non_goals: Do not run checks from policy.
Do not emit pass/fail/block verdicts from policy.
Do not migrate gateway implementation in this task.
verification: search proves live quality policy ownership names are removed.
